mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as liquidity conditions remain accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 5.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract under higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy > 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline year-over-year over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), declining payroll growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1%) signals labor market deterioration that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS growth < 0.1% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust supply-side activity that supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 12-month MA over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1,000,000 units annually signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases (FEDFUNDS) and year-over-year CPIAUCSL declines signal unexpected monetary tightening without inflation relief, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as growth-inflation trade-offs worsen.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL yoy declines over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low industrial production regime (INDPRO < 100.0), further manufacturing output declines (INDPRO growth < 0.5%) signal supply chain disruptions that squeeze corporate margins and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 and INDPRO growth < 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.
